text:
marta: Heads-upwe've got rwd-v5q-beta (4bit NF4lite) on a short A/B against rwd-v4p2 baseline in staging. Can someone post the slice diffs?

kai: ran a 12k-query run across our usual slices (shortqa, longform, multi-step). Quick summary: cost/token ~-38%, BLEURT on longform -2.1, exact-match for shortqa stable, perplexity up slightly on instruction-chains. Latency p50 +7ms p99 +28ms.

devon: paste slice csv (condensed):

```
slice,baseline_BLEURT,candidate_BLEURT,baseline_EM,candidate_EM,baseline_p99_ms,candidate_p99_ms
shortqa,0.82,0.83,71.2,71.0,180,200
longform,0.74,0.62,NA,NA,430,470
multi-step,0.79,0.76,12.1,11.7,320,360
```

riley: that longform BLEURT delta is concerning (-0.12). Does our hallucination detector also flag increased ungrounded facts on that slice?

kai: yes, anchor-based hallucination score +1.4% absolute on longform. We also see more source-omissions on multi-step threads.

anil: current rollout guard (global) is: rollback if fidelity_delta >1.0 (BLEURT/ROUGE mix) OR hallucination_delta>0.8% sustained for 20m x3 windows. Promotion blocked if any safety metric breach was recorded in canary.

sylvia: propose per-slice policy so we don't kill a whole canary for unrelated smallchat drift. Suggested overrides: longform.bleurt_delta=0.8, longform.hallucination_delta=0.6, confirm_windows=3 but window_minutes=10. Also enable drift-alert for instruction-chains.

marta: agree but let's be conservative for this run. Lower traffic to 1% and enable per-slice sensors. We need a synthetic shadow burn focused on longform talk/summary prompts before deciding.

devon: pushing policy snippet now (will commit to canary config):

```
canary_id: rwd-v5q-beta-1761234001
traffic: 0.01
monitoring:
  window_minutes: 10
  confirm_windows: 3
  per_slice_metrics:
    - slice: longform
      bleurt_delta: 0.8
      hallucination_delta: 0.6
    - slice: multi-step
      bleurt_delta: 0.5
      omission_delta: 0.4
  global_metrics:
    - name: latency.p99
      delta_ms: 25.0
auto_fallback: true
logging_tags: ["quant-nf4-beta","no-promote-until-shadow"]
```

ops-bot: Rule applied -> monitoring active for canary rwd-v5q-beta-1761234001. Will post an alert and revert on confirmed breach. :robot_face:

riley: queued a 75k shadow job concentrated on longform prompts and multi-step chains (job id: sj-1761234, ETA ~80m).

sylvia: I'll draft a short rollback playbook and a ready-to-send comms blurb for on-call. Draft comms: "Auto-fallback executed for canary rwd-v5q-beta at {ts}. Traffic rolled back to baseline. Running targeted shadow diagnostics (sj-1761234) to isolate longform regressions."

anil: also tagging canary metadata with model_hash and quant_config so promotion checks can't be bypassed. Added tag `promotion_block:longform-failure` to the job.

kai: small asklet's enable trace-level token-diff logging for a sample subset (5%) of longform responses so evals can inspect where grounding fails. Keep canary live at 1% until shadow completes.

marta: ack. When shadow finishes, compile a per-slice report and we can decide promote vs reject. If auto-fallback triggers, follow sylvia's comms and postmortem template.

kai: TL;DR: reduced canary to 1%, per-slice thresholds tightened for longform, 75k shadow job queued, ops-bot will auto-revert on confirmed breach, promotion blocked until shadow pass + manual sign-off. Thanks.
